message.content:
Vertical turbine pumps are classified in heading 8413.70 (other centrifugal pumps). Parts of pumps fall under 8413.91. Subheading 8413.91.90 covers parts of pumps other than those of 8413.20 and similar, and the statistical suffix is 8413.91.9010 or 8413.91.9090 depending on the part.

Before 2022, the 8413.91 breakdown was: 8413.91.10 for parts of pumps of subheading 8413.20 (hand pumps), 8413.91.20 for parts of 8413.11 and 8413.19 (pumps fitted with measuring devices), and 8413.91.90 for other parts. The statistical suffixes under 8413.91.90 are 8413.91.9010 (of pumps of 8413.30, fuel/lubricating/cooling pumps for internal-combustion engines), 8413.91.9040 (other parts of pumps of 8413.40 or 8413.50...), and so on.

I recall 8413.91.9085 as "Other: Other." This seems right, so I will use that: 8413.91.9085.
